gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade 2 Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade 3 Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade 4 Glioma
Patient must have histologically confirmed IDH-WT gliomas (grade 2-4) as per World Health Organization (WHO) 2016 or 2021 classification

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is not named; eligible are IDH-wildtype grade 2-4 gliomas, with grade 4 IDH-WT glioma equal to glioblastoma. Could be coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: Erdafitinib (other names: Balversa, JNJ 42756493, JNJ-42756493, JNJ42756493): Given PO

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The disease should be recurrent or progressive glioma after initial anti-tumor treatment with at least 1 line of treatment including surgical resection, radiation therapy and/or chemotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive erdafitinib PO QD on days 1-28 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: blocking the action of an abnormal FGFR protein that signals tumor cells to multiply

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue should be positive for FGFR-TACC gene fusion as per any local next generation sequencing (NGS)
Patient must have histologically confirmed IDH-WT gliomas (grade 2-4) as per World Health Organization (WHO) 2016 or 2021 classification

coder_notes: Eligible: IDH-wildtype glioma grades 2-4 with FGFR-TACC fusion; GBM not named explicitly (WHO grade 4 glioma in conditions). Erdafitinib is an FGFR inhibitor, so FGFR-TACC is candidate-matched.
